title: Parity
does: Replays journeys, probes and verified claims on the original and the rebuild from identical fresh states and diffs what clients see.

inputs.label: Scenarios (journeys + probe plan)
Acceptance suite (verified probes)
Masked fields and accepted differences
inputs.preview:
ignore: id, createdAt, walletId, fromWalletId, toWalletId
accepted: probe: send money [amount=4.35]

outputs.label: Parity report
outputs.preview:
# Parity report

48 of 49 cases match, 1 accepted, 0 open (diff rate 0.0%).

## Accepted differences (reviewed quirks)
- probe: send money [amount=4.35]: Original rejects some valid amounts (4.35 * 100 is not exact in floating point). Rebuild accepts them on purpose.

## Open differences
No differences.
